description: Monday 19:40: Joanne uploads a phone photo, IMG_3171.jpg, to the shared 5759 folder (a new file; its created and modified times and the folder's modified time are 19:40): her mortgage servicer's letter of October 19, 'Notice of Special Flood Hazard Determination', from Saturday's mail. FEMA's revised flood map for Hillsborough County, effective October 16, 2026, puts the house in flood zone AE (base flood elevation 9 ft; the 2004 determination was zone X), so the lender requires flood insurance. Her pen circles the zone line and asks in the margin whether it changes anything. Nothing announces it.
